title: Beef Kebab Tikka
description: A flavorful Venezuelan-inspired Indian-style beef kebab dish. Marinated in yogurt and spices, grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, red chili powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add minced garlic and mix well.
Add beef skewers to the marinade and mix until coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove skewers from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as basmati rice and naan bread.
